calculation.description: Fades each asset's five-session return relative to the cross-sectional median, normalizing by trailing 60-session volatility. The reversal signal is amplified when the lagged 20-session DXY return is positive, a risk-off dollar-rally condition. DXY is observation-only and never traded.
calculation.causal_timing: At date t use closes through t; forward return is close[t+5]/close[t]-1.

validation.regime_notes: IC remained positive across 2020-2024 (+0.050104), 2025-2027 (+0.039013), 2028-2029 (+0.035062), and 2030-04-02 (+0.006280), but recent performance is near-neutral and should be monitored.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC over all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; dates require at least 8 valid instruments; no future data used.
